chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 — No Stimulus (3 points) — Set 2: Italian Renaissance
chunks.content: AP European History SAQ 3 (No Stimulus), 3 points, one per part. Set 2 prompts: A [1] describe one significant cultural characteristic of the Italian Renaissance; B [1] describe one political or economic factor that facilitated the Italian Renaissance; C [1] explain one way the Northern Renaissance differed from the Italian Renaissance. 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: A naming a figure without a cultural characteristic; C stating a difference without explaining it.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 3A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 2) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Described a cultural characteristic (e.g., humanism/classical revival), a facilitating political/economic factor (e.g., wealthy merchant patronage), and explained a Northern-vs-Italian Renaissance difference. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 3B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 2) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 0, C 1). Described a cultural characteristic (A) and explained a Northern-vs-Italian difference (C) but did not give a valid facilitating political/economic factor (B). Illustrates missing the causal-factor part.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 3 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 3C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 3 (Set 2) scored 1/3 (A 0, B 1, C 0). Earned only B (a facilitating political/economic factor). Lost A (no valid cultural characteristic) and C (no explained difference from the Northern Renaissance). Illustrates a response that identifies a facilitating factor but misses the cultural characteristic and the comparison.
